_meta.notes: *** THE FILENAME GIVES NO PERIOD AND THE DOCUMENT SUPPLIES ONE. *** 'dea-theadore-2.pdf' (note the misspelling of the candidate's surname in the county's filename - the form spells it THEODORE) is Dea Theodore's 2021 YEAR-END report: the cover is the '2021 Financial Disclosure Report For a Candidate', the YEAR-END box ('January 31 of each year') is the only Type-of-Report box checked, the report is signed 1/31/22, the clerk's RECEIVED stamp reads JAN 31 2022, and every page carries the filer's own 'Date of Report 1/31/22' header. The document is a 3-page report (its own headers read Page 1/2/3 of 3) plus an unnumbered cover = the 4 PDF pages. The chunk file's 2022-01-31 / Year-End / form-2021 metadata is therefore CONFIRMED at the page, and unlike the McAdams filing in this chunk the printed title year IS the period year. OFFICE: the cover's 'Office' line reads only 'County Council' with no district; the separate 'Office Sought' line reads 'County Council' with District Number '6', which is what confirms the chunk file's District 6. Party is written as the single letter 'R'. AMENDMENT: NEITHER the Yes nor the No box is ticked; is_amendment recorded as ''. ZERO GLYPHS: this filer uses a SLASHED ZERO, and it appears four times - Summary line 1 Column A, Summary line 4, and both the SUBTOTAL and TOTAL cells of the blank Schedule A. All four are read as 0 under the repo-wide zero-glyph ruling, with the glyph named here; none is treated as a blank. TWO DATES WITHHELD: rows 1 and 7 carry an overwritten year digit that will not resolve (see their row notes) - dates BLANK + needs_review=1, verbatim in the note, never completed from the report period. Their AMOUNTS are unaffected and the page subtotal still gates exactly. PRIVACY: on the cover the county's black bar UNDER-COVERS the Street Address row - a partial address line is visible below the bar; it was discarded at read time and is written nowhere. The Schedule A address column is moot (the schedule is empty). NO CONTRIBUTION ROWS, so no Occupation/Employer cells were captured; the column exists on p3 and is empty because the schedule is empty.

contributions.detail: The county Schedule A page (p3) is present and WHOLLY BLANK - all 15 grid rows empty - and the filer wrote a SLASHED ZERO in both its SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE and its TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED cells, and again in Summary line 1 Column A and line 4. ZERO-GLYPH RULING (owner 2026-08-02): a glyph denoting zero IS 0, with the verbatim glyph kept in the note - so this is a STATED zero, not a blank, and zero rows reconcile against it exactly. Column B line 1 nonetheless carries an aggregate 13,213.99, which is consistent: no contributions THIS period on top of a cycle that had them.

expenditures.detail: 8 rows sum to 701.88 = the printed 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE' on p4 = Summary line 2 Column A = Summary line 6. The schedule's own 'TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE' grand-total cell is printed and LEFT BLANK by the filer, so schedule_total is honestly '' and the gate used is the page subtotal. SCOPE TEST: the subtotal equals Column A (701.88), NOT Column B (9,691.63), so the transcribed rows are the per-period scope, matching summary-line-2.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: p4 rows 701.88 = printed SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE 701.88 (EXACT). p4's TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE cell is printed and left BLANK. p3 prints a slashed-zero in BOTH its subtotal and its total, against a wholly empty grid.
itemized.escalation_note: p4 date column rows 1-3 and rows 6-8 at 800 dpi; then three 1200 dpi single-cell crops of the two-digit year on row 1, row 7 and (as the control) row 2. The control settles the filer's plain '21'; the two disputed cells are overwrites and were left BLANK rather than guessed.
